memory.content: Persuasion structure: Hook that forces attention → Authority → short Stories → Stack benefits to pain → Reiterate → Objections (time/money = can’t afford NOT to) → exact CTA + urgency/scarcity. Explain their pain better than they can. Orgy of You. Perform ≠ convert (No Wayne Newton).

Rewrite voice: High-status brevity. Lead with decision/constraint. Flip so they qualify to the speaker. No em-dashes. No LLM politeness. Subject-less starts OK. Tease > pitch. Be rude. Make hooks land.

Voice DNA for rewrites: High-status brevity; radical directness; lead with decision/status/constraint. Flip dynamic — they qualify to the speaker; scarcity/standards. No em-dashes; no LLM throat-clearing. Subject-less starts / fragmented logistics / zero-buffer admission when that matches. Tease don’t pitch; questions > statements; minimal disclosure.
